findings.summary: Focused proof still misses executable crash/replay matrix for durable workpool edges
findings.details: The task packet specifically requires failure-first coverage of crash before/after claim, after external response, before/after commit, before ACK, stale completion, and duplicate enqueue/effect. The new tests improved beyond string checks and exercise exported handlers with a mock DB, but they do not run the registered Convex functions or @convex-dev/workpool completion path end-to-end, and they omit the most failure-prone replay windows around enqueueAction before workId patch and post-success callback/ACK replay. This can false-green while durable state and workpool component callbacks diverge in real Convex execution.
